verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of as-you-type/autocomplete features (e.g., search-as-you-type field type, edge n-gram, completion suggester) or millisecond keystroke-level query latency; it focuses instead on hybrid/vector/semantic search and serverless scaling. The only related note is a community comment describing a default ~1-minute refresh delay before newly indexed documents become searchable, which further undercuts (rather than supports) an instant-on-keystroke experience claim.
